context: This takes place in the Audience Hall during Gortash’s ceremony to become Grand Duke (the opening lines vary depending on whether the Steel Watchers — his elite guards — are present). Several patriars and nobles are in attendance and Karlach is on the far side of the room, furious at Gortash for past wrongs but being urged not to start a fight. Gortash greets the player as a known associate — even calling them his “favourite assassin” / Bhaalspawn — then tells the player to kill Orin before he concludes the ceremony. There is a telepathic warning from allies not to be swept up in Karlach’s rage and reminders that an attack on Gortash now would likely leave the player to fight alone; while the player can try to strike, they would be heavily outmatched.
